source: hand-written for the M6' teacher-distillation pilot (2026-07-29)
note: Teacher-generation spec list, NOT an eval suite. Deliberately disjoint from text-to-cad / organic / heldout-cqe (contamination guard enforces this). Tiers: 1 = prismatic + simple features, 2 = multi-feature / compound, 3 = freeform surfaces (spline / loft / sweep / revolve). Group F+G exercise NURBS and surface modelling, where the deterministic gate is weakest and hand-checking matters most.
